notes.title: The future of Voxel Vanguard
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Dan here:

This is the first time I write some kind of update for Voxel Vanguard.

For those who don't know, we were working on a demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest but due to personal circumstances, we wouldn't have had the time to provide an enjoyable experience in time.
Thus we decided to participate in the next festival this year.
With more time we will be able to polish and create a greater experience for our players.

I personally apologize to anyone who expected to play Voxel Vanguard, but I believe it will be a greater experience to have a better product from the beginning. 

In other news, we are working on new features that we hope will make the game richer and fun to play.

Also, don't forget to join our newsletter if you want to hear the latest news and get freebies, like free keys and other perks.
